verdict.rationale: Docs show a documented API/contract model for creating subscriptions (create-a-contract, PLG onboarding), updating pricing, seats, and trials (manage-subscription-lifecycle, manage-seats), all via API with idempotency, pagination, and bearer-token auth — a solid developer-facing lifecycle API. However, explicit 'pause' and 'cancel' subscription operations are never mentioned in the evidence; only creation, pricing/seat changes, and upgrades/downgrades are documented. Missing for 10: explicit pause-subscription endpoint, explicit cancel-subscription endpoint, and independent/hands-on confirmation these lifecycle actions work end-to-end without dashboard use.
